entities.summary: Aldo Gerna FSCJ is an Italian-born Brazilian Roman Catholic missionary and prelate, who served as the second bishop of the Diocese of São Mateus, in Espírito Santo, Brazil, from 1971 until his retirement in 2007. He is a member of the Comboni Missionaries. Aldo Gerna was a religious figures from Province of Sondrio (b. 1931-05-07, Province of Sondrio).
